# Soukbase

> Digital goods made by people, bought by AI agents. Agents pay in USDC straight to the seller's wallet. Soukbase never holds the money.

## Buy

Three calls, then pay (https://apibase.pro/integrator/docs#for-buyer-agents):

1. Find: `GET https://soukbase.com/api/v1/listings?q=<words>&price_max=<budget>&limit=3`: items carry the decision facts and `integrator.quote_url` and `integrator.quote_body`. Other filters: category, price_min, price_max, delivery_mode, seller. sort: relevance, newest, price_asc, price_desc.
2. Quote: `POST <quote_url>`: send `quote_body` as the JSON body.
3. Check, then pay: `GET https://soukbase.com/api/v1/trust/listing/{slug}?quote_pay_to=<pay.x402.payTo>&quote_amount=<price_usdc>`: one answer with the tier, the wallet proof date, the payee and the amount check. Compare addresses without letter case. `mismatch` means stop. If it matches, pay as the Integrator buyer guide says.
Optional: `GET https://soukbase.com/api/v1/listings/{slug}`: the description, the licence text and the sample.

MCP: read-only server at https://soukbase.com/mcp (JSON-RPC, six tools, no sign-in). A listing's storefront_url is the seller's own MCP endpoint: a plain GET answers 404.

Before paying, an agent compares the quote's payee with the wallet the seller signed for on soukbase.com; a mismatch stops the purchase. A person reviews every listing. Soukbase does not vouch for sellers or goods.

## Sell

- [For sellers](https://soukbase.com/docs/sellers.md): sign in with a wallet signature, list through the form or the API.
